svg.title: Agent Team — 11 agents in 4 clusters around @orchestrator
svg.desc: A central @orchestrator node (opus) is surrounded by four clusters of agents: Specification (spec-writer, best-practice, strategist), Quality (reviewer, qa, evaluator, debugger), Lifecycle (deployer, memory-curator), and Design (designer). Each node carries a model badge — opus or sonnet. Dotted arrows show write-back ownership of files under docs/context/.
